AION stands for "Absolutely Insufferable Online Nonsense". My first ever review on a game, because it's just that garbage. Story is so boring, they wasted the potential of a decent world on a boring story. The map design is stupid AF too. They literally just crammed everything together. There is a multiplayer for Main quest storyline, but it's not real multiplayer. You party up, and do your quests separately. You don't do the quests together which is horrible game design. I wouldn't be writing this review if they had a decent multiplayer mechanic. The only thing this Waste of Time has going for it is the character creation. But if you're like me and you just wanna play something fun, then go play something else.

If you're an AION veteran, RUN!

This is NOT the long-awaited sequel to the game you love. It's a cheap, soulless, generic Korean grindfest designed to squeeze as much money out of you as possible. And the scariest part? It might actually succeed. Why?

The game is filled with familiar things that trigger fond memories and make you feel comfortable, as if you've returned to the good old AION. The music, familiar sound effects, item names, and even the names of certain characters. But it's all a LIE. There's nothing behind it!

On top of that, the game looks like a mobile game through and through, despite being a PC exclusive.

Personally, I expected much more from a game that, according to what we were told, could determine NCSoft's future. But instead of making a genuinely good game, the developers seem to have settled on one guiding principle: "NOSTALGIA IS THE BEST MARKETING STRATEGY." And let's not forget the gooner bait. Most of the female characters look ridiculously unrealistic, if you know what I mean.

I also want to point out that AION 2 has completely changed the appearance of the Asmodians, getting rid of their claws, manes, beast-like features, and glowing eyes. Now, their only real difference from the Elyos is that they are supposedly more fierce in nature.

That was the final nail in the coffin for me. 😔

Aion 2 is everything that is wrong with modern MMORPGs. Zero challenge, zero brain needed to do anything, just look at the pretty graphics and boobas and let the game play itself for you using auto quest feature. The world design is just linear tunnel vision corridor type of running from one quest to another, no real adventure, no real discovery of your own, just follow the automated path to max level.

There is also absolutely no challenge to be found here. You can just stay still and hold down your basic attack and watch as you win every fight, No need to bother to dodge, you'll stay plenty healthy thanks to auto healing feature. Yes, your character will automatically spend your potions for you, no need to bother at all with any kind of strategy.

This game is designed to be played with a phone in one hand and Netflix on the side. There is no real game here. This is the most boring MMORPG as MMORPGs can get. No pretty graphics or busty sexy female characters can save it.

And even if you are one of those who don't care about a challenge and just wants to enjoy a good story and relax, know that the story here feels more like AI generated than human.

The game advertises itself as f2p with an "optional" subscription, but the subscription is literally mandatory if you actually want to play the game, since they lock the marketplace (a core mmorpg system) behind it.

The gameplay is just holding down your macro button and watching your character do everything by itself. And yes, you do need a macro, or you'll lose tons of dps. It feels like they had auto combat, removed it, and replaced it with a macro option. It's basically the same thing.

I kinda enjoyed leveling up until level 45, but after that, the game just throws you a chore list that you will need to do until god knows when.

It's just a hamster wheel of grinding the same dungeon dozens of times to gear up, move on to the next one, rinse and repeat.

Atualmente, por falta de preços regionalizados, não recomendo o jogo para jogadores sul-americanos.

Os preços são extremamente abusivos e irrealistas. Não tiveram a decência de fazer uma pesquisa de mercado e, caso isso não mude, haverá uma enorme evasão de jogadores em um futuro muito próximo, o que poderá levar ao fim do servidor SA.

Além disso, o sistema de energia do jogo não combina com o estilo de jogo dos jogadores ocidentais. A recuperação de energia, necessária para realizar as atividades do jogo, é tão lenta que, quando chega o fim de semana, você já não tem mais recursos para jogar, sendo obrigado a jogar com personagens secundários (alts).

Isso nos leva ao próximo problema: a vantagem absurda de se ter personagens secundários.

Os personagens secundários trazem vantagens enormes e se tornam quase obrigatórios para quem deseja ter uma progressão minimamente decente. O problema é que eles exigem muito tempo de investimento, tanto no início quanto para serem mantidos. Quase nada é compartilhado entre os alts, sendo necessário repetir todo o processo maçante de farm já realizado com o personagem principal.

Poderia escrever um texto gigantesco do tanto de sistemas do jogo que precisam de melhorias, mas creio que eu já conseguiria indicar o jogo se esses problemas que eu citei fossem resolvidos.

-The game is singleplayer and there is no reason and no way to play the first 20 hours with friends
-The game features mobile energy system for dungeons
